description: This file defines a linked list data structure with basic operations such as add, remove, size, and get, implemented in Kotlin for an Android frontend project.

classes.name: LinkedList
classes.description: A singly linked list implementation with methods to add, remove, get size, and access elements by index.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new element to the end of the linked list.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the first occurrence of the specified element from the list.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the list.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the element at the specified index in the list.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Private helper method to detach a node from the list.

methods.name: tail
methods.description: Private companion object method to find the last node in the list.
